label: Space program
blurb: A near-future space agency: astronauts, mission control, rocket engineers and the crews of an orbital station and a lunar base. Grounded, realistic spaceflight rather than far-future sci-fi.
context: near-future space program astronaut character, realistic modern spaceflight gear with plain unbranded patches
negative: agency logo, NASA logo, national flag, flag patch, lettering, text on clothing

playing guitar in the crew quarters

cooking elaborate meals from freeze-dried food

counting down from ten before anything important
wearing {poss} lucky socks on every launch day
talking in mission-control jargon at dinner
timing every task with a wristwatch
keeping a photo of {poss} dog on every flight

writing everything in tiny capital letters
